verdict.rationale: Superhuman ships a first-party Superhuman Mail MCP that connects the inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants. Through it, agents can summarize threads, draft and send emails (with explicit send approval), and schedule meetings across multiple Gmail/Outlook accounts, and a probe confirms the official MCP page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP in use, and detailed technical setup docs (endpoint, auth flow, tool list).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools. You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar
Every send action requires your explicit approval, so you stay in control.
Manage every inbox and calendar from one AI assistant, without complicated workarounds.
